LNS_framework.definition: Large Neighborhood Search that iteratively selects and replans subsets of agents

collision_based_neighborhood_selection.definition: Select agents based on collision graph using BFS from most-colliding agent

MARL_policy.definition: Decentralized policy using local FOV observations for collision-aware path planning
MARL_policy.faithful: partially - uses hand-crafted heuristics instead of trained neural network
MARL_policy.deviation: Policy uses scoring heuristics (goal progress, collision avoidance, density, anti-loop) instead of learned CNN/LSTM weights

adaptive_switching.definition: Transition from MARL to PP based on collision reduction ratio

prioritized_planning.definition: Sequential path planning with constraint propagation

space_time_astar.definition: A* on time-expanded graph with hard and soft constraints

deviations: MARL policy uses hand-crafted heuristics instead of trained neural network
Agent counts capped for computational feasibility
Time limit shorter than benchmark standard (5s vs 5min)
